LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_LosePassionsDesc: If enabled, the prisoner loses skill passions and skill levels when their mind breaks.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_GainTraitDesc: If enabled, the prisoner gains a permanent unstable trait upon psychological deconstruction.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_GainTortureTraitDesc: If enabled, the prisoner gains the severe 'Mutilated Mind' trait after physical torture.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_ApplyCatatoniaDesc: If enabled, the prisoner falls into catatonia right after their mind breaks.
LanguageData.ShatteredLoyalty_BreakSpeedDesc: Adjusts the speed at which prisoner resistance is reduced.
